result.summary: Found 3 layout issues: category filter carousel overflow, truncated restaurant card in the fastest section, and a partially cut-off restaurant card at the bottom of the page.

issues.description: The category filter buttons extend beyond the viewport with the rightmost button partially hidden/cut off
issues.suggestion: Implement proper carousel scrolling, add scroll indicators, or adjust button sizing to ensure all category buttons are fully visible or properly scrollable

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section (Smash Bros Bu) appears truncated with incomplete text
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll area to properly display all cards or implement a carousel with proper overflow handling and navigation controls

issues.description: The last restaurant card in 'Popular right now' section is partially cut off at the bottom of the visible area
issues.suggestion: Review the card container height and spacing to ensure the last card is fully visible or provide clear indication that more content is available below
